table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	PatientName = P.Name,
	Date = S.Date,
	InvoiceCode = S.SaleInvCode,
	InvoiceAmount = S.InvTotal,
	Remarls = S.Remarks
FROM
	SaleLedger S,
	Patient P
WHERE 
	S.PatientCode = :ai_patientcode AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.PatientCode = P.PatientCode
ORDER BY
	P.Name,
	P.RegNo,
	S.Date
